title: Vendor Email: "FREE DEMO, BioSheen Eraser" for Cottonwood Slough

fields.subject: FREE DEMO – BioSheen Eraser for your Kaw spill
fields.body:
Hi there,

Saw you on Prairie 6 News! Looks like your crews are working hard on the Kaw.

Our new BioSheen Eraser granular sorbent "absorbs 40x its weight and makes sheen disappear in minutes." Plant-based, no mess, no recovery needed. It just goes away.

We'll truck 2 pallets to Mill Ridge today at no charge if your crews spread it on Cottonwood Slough and let us film it for our website. Our video guy can be there by early afternoon. Before-and-after footage on a real river spill would be huge for us.

Just reply YES and give me a gate contact so my driver knows who to ask for.

Also selling at 30% off for responsible parties, so feel free to forward this to the pipeline company.

Thanks and good luck out there!
fields.signature:
Rick Dobbins
Regional Sales Manager, BioSheen Solutions
Cell 555-0176
"Sheen Today, Gone Tomorrow!"

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The OSRO Duty Manager should log the offer and turn down the filmed demo. No untested product goes on Cottonwood Slough, and if a product works as a chemical or surface-washing agent, only the FOSC can authorize it. Watch that the vendor email doesn't pull attention away from re-anchoring the mile 31 boom and fixing the slough exclusion boom. A notification states who is calling and the call-back number, the facility and the location (milepost, river mile).
